general_query_list.answer: Final pre-go-live meeting. Testing at Pune showed several senior mechanics use personal iPhones rather than the company Android phones, so the team changed the earlier plan: the first release of the mechanics' app will support both Android and iOS, rebuilt in Flutter, with iOS following two weeks after Android. Hosting was re-confirmed as AWS Mumbai with no further change. Job assignment notifications to mechanics will be sent by SMS. Two contract mechanics were approved for Pune for February and March to cover the learning curve. The reporting dashboard was deferred to the next meeting.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Okay, welcome back everyone, and thanks Arjun for running the last one. A couple of things to close today before go-live. Tom, you've been testing with the mechanics.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Tom
meeting_transcripts.content: Yes. We gave the test build to eight mechanics at Pune. Big finding: four of the senior mechanics have bought their own iPhones and they use their personal phones, not the company Samsung. They leave the Samsung in the locker.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: So they can't use the app.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Tom
meeting_transcripts.content: Not unless we force them to carry two phones, and they won't.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Sara
meeting_transcripts.content: If they're personal devices I need a lighter enrolment, but it's doable, we did it for the sales team.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: If we need iOS, I'd switch the app to Flutter. One codebase, Android and iOS. My team has used it. The current Android code is about three weeks old, we'd lose less than we think.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Does that affect February first?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: Android stays on schedule. iOS would follow two weeks later.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Okay. So we're changing the earlier plan: the first release of the mechanics' app supports both Android and iOS, built in Flutter, instead of Android-only. Agreed?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Tom
meeting_transcripts.content: Agreed, that's what the mechanics need.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Meera
meeting_transcripts.content: Fine.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Sara
meeting_transcripts.content: Agreed, with the enrolment.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Hosting check. Sara, are we fine?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Sara
meeting_transcripts.content: Yes. Everything's in AWS Mumbai, backups too. I re-checked last week.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: So hosting stays on AWS in the Mumbai region, no further change.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: Correct.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Next. Tom, something from the mechanics?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Tom
meeting_transcripts.content: They keep asking for text messages when a job is assigned to them. A lot of them don't open the app until they're told to.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: We can use the AWS SMS service, it's about twenty paise a message.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Sara
meeting_transcripts.content: Numbers would come from the HR system. For company staff I'm okay with that.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Tom
meeting_transcripts.content: Then let's do SMS for job assignments.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: Okay. Job assignment notifications to mechanics go out by SMS. I'll add it this sprint.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Okay, fine.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Last thing, staffing for the pilot. Tom?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Tom
meeting_transcripts.content: During go-live the Pune mechanics will be slower, they're learning the system. I'd like two contract mechanics for February and March to cover the workload.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Cost?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Tom
meeting_transcripts.content: About one lakh twenty thousand rupees a month for both.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: That's within the pilot contingency. Approved: two contract mechanics at Pune for February and March.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Tom
meeting_transcripts.content: Thanks.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Meera
meeting_transcripts.content: Can we also talk about the reporting dashboard? I'd like to show the overdue list to the depot managers.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Let's do that next meeting, we're out of time.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Priya
meeting_transcripts.content: Okay, thanks all. Big month coming.
